case_name: Smt. Gowthami K vs Sri. Shivaprasad B.R
facts_of_case: Marriage of the parties was solemnized on 23.02.2017 at Challakere, Chitradurga District. They have one child aged about 4 years. Petitioner is not working and has no income of her own.

legal_principles.principle: In a petition filed under Section 24 of CPC for transfer of proceedings, more particularly, in matrimonial cases, the Court shall have regard to the convenience and expediency of the parties.
legal_principles.held: The court shall have regard to the convenience and expediency of the parties.

legal_principles.principle: The court shall consider the convenience and expediency of the parties in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: I am of the view that petition is liable to be allowed.
cited_cases: Smt. Gowthami K vs Sri. Shivaprasad B.R, (2023) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Petition to transfer M.C.No.43/2023 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Challakere to the Court of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Madhugiri for disposal.
